Tosafot on Bava Batra 69a:10:1.hebrew: ולא את חיצת הקנים כו' - אע"ג דקטיני. עוד יאריך לקמן על משנה זו, ובההיא דשומירה וחרוב; אלא כן דרך הגמרא, שמתחלה מפרש המשנה ואח"כ מאריך:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 69a:10:1.english: "Nor the hedge of reeds, etc." - Even though they are small. [The Gemara] will elaborate further below on this Mishnah, and on that case of the watchtower and the carob; but this is the way of the Gemara: first it explains the Mishnah, and afterward it elaborates:

Tosafot on Bava Batra 69a:12:1.hebrew: בעי ר' אלעזר מלבנות פתחים - לא כפי' הקונטרס דאפתח הבית קאי, דהא לא איירי כלל במכר בית. אלא נראה לר"י דאפתח שומירה קאי, ואשומירה דרישא קאי, דקתני דמכר את השומירה:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 69a:12:1.english: Rabbi Elazar asked: the frames of doorways - [This is] not like the explanation of the Kuntres (Rashi), that it refers to the doorway of the house, for [the Gemara] is not discussing the sale of a house at all. Rather, it appears to Ri that it refers to the doorway of the watchman's hut (shomira), and it refers to the shomira in the first clause [of the Mishnah], which teaches that he sold the shomira:

Tosafot on Bava Batra 69a:2:1.hebrew: והוא דמחתן - אין נראה לפרש לר"י דמחתי על העומרי'. דמה אנו צריכין שיהו מונחים על העומרים? הואיל והעומרים שהן תלושין אינן מכורין. ונראה לר"י דלא מחתן היינו שמעולם לא הניחו על העומרים, ומחתן היינו שכבר הונחו, ולאו דמחתי השתא:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 69a:2:1.english: "Provided that he placed them" - It does not seem right to Rabbeinu Yitzchak to explain that "machatei" means that he placed them on the sheaves. For why would we need them to be resting on the sheaves, given that the sheaves, which are detached [from the ground], are not sold [along with the field]? Rather, it seems to Rabbeinu Yitzchak that "lo machatan" means that they never placed them on the sheaves, and "machatan" means that they had already been placed there, and not that he is placing them now.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 69a:4:1.hebrew: מחולקין - בערוך פירש שהסירו הקליפות, כדי שלא יתליעו:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 69a:4:1.english: Mechulakin (split/peeled) - In the Arukh he explained that they removed the peels, so that they would not become wormy:
